'''2008 Worlds Team Jerry Chu LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jerry Chu]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Team Tournament). Informal notebook. Team Albany goes to MN. Teammate Mike Dearborn. Sheet name Jerry Chu.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jerry Chu]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|You Can Either Profit By This...]]
* '''Stage:''' Team Tournament
